verdict.rationale: Databricks ships Genie Code, a built-in AI assistant that generates/runs code, builds pipelines and dashboards, debugs errors, and can run as an autonomous agent that plans, executes code, fixes errors and asks approval before tool use — directly matching 'delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant.' It also supports parallel chats and can be given governed tool access (Slack, GitHub, etc.) via MCP for agentic task execution. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user validation of agentic delegation quality is absent from community evidence.
